details.description: Mistral-7B-OpenOrca is a 7-billion-parameter chat model fine-tuned by Open-Orca from Mistral 7B on a curated, filtered subset of the OpenOrca dataset, which reproduces the augmented instruction data described in Microsoft Research's Orca paper. Training used the Axolotl framework with OpenChat-style sequence packing. The model card reports it reaching 106% of the base Mistral-7B model's average performance on the Hugging Face Open LLM Leaderboard and ranking first among openly available models under 30B parameters at its release. It is licensed under Apache 2.0.
advantages: Scores 65.84 average on the Hugging Face Open LLM Leaderboard (MMLU, ARC, HellaSwag, TruthfulQA), per the model card.
The model card reports reaching 106% of the base Mistral-7B model's Open LLM Leaderboard average, and ranking first among openly available models under 30B parameters at release.
Scores 83.99% on HellaSwag (10-shot), per the model card.
disadvantages: The model card lists English as the only supported language.
use_cases: Text generation deployable on moderate consumer GPUs

notes: Fireworks' page confirms fireworks/openorca-7b maps to Open-Orca/Mistral-7B-OpenOrca and matches the catalog's 32768-token max_input/max_output (Fireworks states 32.7k). No mention on the model card of this model being superseded or deprecated.
